title: Evaluation and Benchmarking of LLM Agents: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing benchmarks and frameworks (e.g., HELM, FinCon, AutoGuide) that evaluate autonomous decision-making outcomes (such as financial loan approvals) for the reinforcement of systemic inequalities, and utilizing specialized test sets with automated detectors or human raters to measure the frequency of extremely biased statements.
